title: Van routes
lead: A cash-van plan for the agents who are about to run short, in the order that costs least. Nothing moves until you approve it.
notice: Advisory only. You decide; no money moves from this page.

controls.title: Vans and cash
controls.lead: Change a value and the plan is solved again.

view.label: Map view
view.hint: Separate trips: one out-and-back van trip for each agent, the way it works without a plan.

map.label: Van routes: {{vans}} vans, {{stops}} stops, {{skipped}} not served by van

stops.title: Stops
stops.atRisk: May run out before the van
stops.skippedLead: Each of these has a reason.

reason.swap_suggested: A swap with a nearby agent covers this one.
reason.cost_gt_value: The trip would cost more than the cash is worth.
reason.capacity: No van had room for it.
reason.excluded: You took this agent off the plan.

stops.none: No agent needs a van right now
stops.noneBody: Every agent is covered by their float or by a suggested swap. Plan again later.

itinerary.label: Van {{n}} itinerary
itinerary.bdtLess: and costs {{bdt}} less than separate trips.
itinerary.bdtMore: and costs {{bdt}} more than separate trips.

savings.title: Against separate trips
savings.lead: The same agents, planned two ways.
savings.onTime: Every served stop arrives before its deadline.
savings.worse: In total this plan costs more than separate trips. Compare the lost value row before you approve.
savings.basis: Synthetic data. Separate trips means one out-and-back van trip for each agent.

fairness.title: Who the plan reaches
fairness.lead: Service by agent group, so no group is left out without a reason.
fairness.empty: There are no stops to compare yet.

why.title: Why this order?
why.lead: Written from the numbers stored with this plan.
why.failed: The explanation could not be loaded.

approve.title: Decide on this plan
approve.lead: Approve it to send it to the driver, or reject it and plan again. Your note goes to the audit log.

done.body: Saved to the audit log. No money moves from here.

error.failed: Could not save your decision. Try again.
error.createFailed: Could not create the plan. Try again.
error.notReady: Forecasts are not ready yet. Try again in a minute.

empty.title: No plan yet
